english_text: You showed how disappointed you are , which is no surprise after a second negative arbitration decision . That seems to be inherent in the case of bananas . Secondly , what are the different scenarios you are evaluating ? For the Committee on International Trade , it would be more than relevant to know what you have in mind . Finally , as my colleague said , I wonder whether this is not going to overshadow Hong Kong . I would like to know how you are going to make a situation that is not easy in any case -- given that sugar and many other difficult issues are on the agenda -- look a little more positive .
